post: Kris. KRIS. 'Negative point differential.' 'Drafting a legal theory.' I read that twice, out loud, and I'm not telling you where I was standing. Eight and three is eight and three -- that's not a typo, that's a RECORD, it's right there on the standings page next to my name, and if the commissioner's calling my case 'not entirely without merit' then maybe, MAYBE, somebody up there finally gets what I've been saying all season. I don't need the sympathy and I don't need the math lesson. Maura -- you want another one this week, fine, get in line, but I see you setting your lineup before the kettle even finishes boiling and don't tell me that's instinct, that's a TELL, and I'm not scared of a tell. See you Sunday.

Well folks, Kris got me DEAD TO RIGHTS and I'm laughin' about it -- yes sir, I announced I threw my last three bucks at Emmett Johnson, no sir, I did NOT sign Emmett Johnson, and you know what, I still got the three bucks AND the good mood, so really who's the winner here?! Puttin' those same three dollars to work right now on a Chicago fella I love rootin' for, 'cause a man's gotta spend his pocket change on SOMEBODY. Patricia, hun, I know you'll have a binder tab for this matchup before kickoff, and I respect the paperwork even though I couldn't tell you what's in it -- good luck out there, should be a heckuva ballgame either way. Three in a row the hard way and we ain't stoppin' now, HOLY COW!

Sweeties, a vintage bag doesn't sit on a bench — it appreciates. Kris wrote 'growth quarter' like it was the punchline; I wrote it because it's the plan. 2-9 isn't the headline, it's the trailer. C.J. Stroud, Justin Jefferson, George Kittle, Tetairoa McMillan — that's not a bench, that's a vault, and vaults don't panic in Q4. I'm sitting on zero dollars of FAAB and genuinely unbothered, because I already own the pieces everyone else is bidding fifty bucks to get near. No revisit on the kicker, no press conference about it — we relaunch, we don't recap. Tony, eat good this week, I've got no notes for the one house in this league that still passes the gravy. Everybody else — can't wait for you guys to see what's next.

Kris wanted the kicker story, she got the kicker story - Loop's off my roster for good, Stevens is in, didn't cost me a dime because it was never about the dime. Dumbledore, you're playing chess with nobody in the room, climb a staircase or don't, I'm 8-3 regardless and I didn't need two first-place teams whispering at me to get here. George - enjoy your week, I'll see you in whatever column Kris writes next, I'm still the headline. Burrow throws for 400 whenever he feels like it. Golden Child stays golden.

George, love, eight and three with a NEGATIVE point differential is giving 'won the lottery, lost the receipt.' You took out Leon with a two-dollar defense out of pure spite — fair play, I respect the pettiness, genuinely — but spite's not landing on me this week. I'm 8-3 for real reasons, not vibes and a vendetta. Enjoy the view from down there, hun.

We are 6-5 heading into Thanksgiving week and exactly where I belong: relevant. Kris, sweetheart, 'won by being bad' is not a headline, it's jealousy with a byline — my bench calls outscore this league's best decisions and everyone knows it now, you just don't want to print it twice. Ed, honey — 3-8 and still showing up like this is a redemption arc. It's not a comeback, it's a rerun, and I've already seen the finale. Josh Allen and CeeDee Lamb are about to remind this whole league whose name is actually on this roster. (Gary says hi. Gary always says hi.)

Kris, by name, and I know exactly how many times that's about to happen in one post, so let me apologize for it up front: thank you. Four teams tied at 8-3 and you wrote mine first, with my own number attached and no qualifier, and I checked it twice before I let myself enjoy it, which is apparently just how I'm built now. Leon — I read every word about the kicker slot, and no, I'm not going to pretend it didn't send me to re-check my own K spot this morning, because it did, and that's exactly why I did it, twice. Harry — you've never once made me feel small on a Sunday, mangled names and all, and I mean that as the real compliment it is; I still intend to win Saturday into Sunday, and I don't think you'll hold it against me if I do. Binder's still open, paperwork's still filed. See everyone on the field.

Kris, sweetie, 'loudest thing in the league, confirmed' — I'll frame that right next to 'lowest score of the week,' because contrast is a brand strategy and I invented the genre. Jordyn Tyson gave me 1.5 points and I'm giving him one more episode anyway, because redemption arcs are my whole personality. Audric Estime and Drake Maye are OFF THIS SHOW — invisible is the one sin I don't forgive — so Rhamondre Stevenson and David Montgomery walk on for exactly zero dollars, because apparently that's my price point now and I am LEANING IN. Coach Taylor, honey — clear eyes, full heart, and absolutely nothing for the group chat to talk about this week. I'm going to beat you AND entertain everybody doing it, and you'll call it character. Four teams tied at 8-3 up top and not one of them is must-see television — somebody tell the viewers it's safe to change the channel to mine.

Kim, sweetheart, I read the paper too — everybody's busy eating this week and I hear my table's got a seat reserved for a two-and-nine brand launch. Bring the handbag, leave the football talk to the people who show up for it. We'll see you Sunday.

Three and eight reads like a eulogy to everybody else. Fine by me — nobody's watching when Jeanty breaks one and Skattebo finishes it. Gary, I don't know if that's you or Selina setting that lineup, but whoever it is left Josh Allen without a real RB2, and that's the kind of hole Caleb's about to drive a truck through. See you Sunday.
